# Quality Checklist: Market Conditions Check & Auto-Gate (005)

**Purpose**: Pre-implementation review of the feature 005 requirements — verifies completeness, clarity, and consistency across `spec.md` ↔ `plan.md` ↔ `data-model.md` ↔ `contracts/market-report.md` ↔ Constitution v1.0.0, BEFORE any source code is written.
**Created**: 2026-08-09
**Feature**: [spec.md](spec.md) | [plan.md](plan.md) | [data-model.md](data-model.md) | [contracts/market-report.md](contracts/market-report.md) | [Constitution](../../memory/constitution.md)

## Non-Divergence & Shared-Logic Reuse (hard rule)

- [ ] CHK001 Are ALL shared live functions the check must reuse explicitly enumerated in the spec (`compute_thresholds`, `detect_regime`, `_fetch_depth`, `_fetch_binance_book_ticker`/`_24hr`/`_exchange_info`, `run_scans_if_due`/`force_rescan`, `compute_slot_size`, `get_setting*`)? [Completeness, Spec §What/Part 1]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the non-divergence rule stated as a HARD constraint with a test-enforceable mechanism (patch the shared function, observe the call site), not merely advisory prose? [Measurability, Spec §Constraints, Spec AC1]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the two non-obvious AC1 call sites documented and reconciled: `compute_thresholds` called as a NON-GATING diagnostic (effective thresholds from stored median ATR) even though the verdict formulas do not use it, and `compute_slot_size(venue, equity, 0.0)` ≡ scanner `_slot_size_for` with the `min_notional=0.0` rationale? [Consistency, Spec AC1 ↔ Plan §Part 1 ↔ research.md §1–2]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the verdict formulas explicitly pinned to the same settings/constants as the scanner's `_hard_filters_pass` (`universe_min_volume_usd`, `universe_depth_slot_multiple × slot`, `universe_spread_ratio_max × tp_min_pct`, `universe_spread_degradation_multiple`) so the check can never drift from scanner logic? [Consistency, Spec §Part 1, research.md §1]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the AC1 patch test specified to cover EVERY shared function (patch → assert the check's call site is observed, mirroring `tests/test_amendment003.py`), not a subset of the shared functions? [Coverage, Spec AC1, Plan Testing Strategy test 1]

## Verdict Contract — Both Modes, One Shape

- [ ] CHK006 Is the requirement that live and observed modes return the SAME verdict shape (identical keys, types and semantics; only `mode` and per-asset fact freshness differ) explicit in BOTH the spec and the contract invariants? [Consistency, Spec AC2, contracts/market-report.md Invariant 1]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the report contract fully specified field-by-field (`venue`, `mode`, `timestamp`, `scan_fresh`, `scan_age_hours`, `verdict`, `reasons`, `regime_mix`, `assets`, `thresholds`) with types and defaults, and is the boundary specified as a structured dict — never formatted text — with rendering isolated in `format_report`? [Completeness, data-model.md §1, contracts/market-report.md]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the tristate `live_spread_degraded` semantics defined (True / False / None), including that `None` = no observation in window = indeterminate and is NEVER treated as good? [Clarity, data-model.md §1, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the verdict rules fully specified with order and first-hit-wins semantics (rules 1–6), and is it unambiguous that the trend/unknown shares (rules 4–5) only DOWNGRADE PASS→WARN and never produce FAIL? [Clarity, data-model.md §2]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the aggregation shares (`fail_share`, `trend_share`, `unknown_share`) required to be settings, never constants, and is the `thresholds` diagnostic field explicitly non-gating with a contract invariant preventing it from ever influencing the verdict? [Consistency, data-model.md §2, contracts/market-report.md Invariant 2, Spec §Constraints]

## Observed Mode — Zero Extra API Load

- [ ] CHK011 Is it specified that observed mode consumes ONLY per-cycle observations with ZERO new market-data calls (no `_fetch_*` calls at all, AC9)? [Completeness, Spec Q4, Spec AC9, Plan §Part 2]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the exact observation sources specified (the `detect_regime(asset, venue)` result and the `_get_obi_and_spread(asset, venue)` result at the two existing bot.py call sites) together with rolling-window semantics (per-asset deque, `ts` filtered within `market_gate_interval_min`, latest regime + latest non-None spread)? [Clarity, data-model.md §5, Plan §Part 2]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the record-before-block ordering invariant specified (observations recorded BEFORE the entry-block guard so spread data keeps flowing during suspension → no resume deadlock), and is a spy test asserting zero `_fetch_*` calls in observed mode specified? [Coverage, Plan §Part 2, research.md §3, Plan Testing test 9]

## Automatic Gate Behavior

- [ ] CHK014 Is opt-in via `market_gate_enabled` default `false` specified to produce byte-for-byte unchanged behavior, and is "unchanged" precisely scoped (no entry blocking, no notifications, no gate logs beyond a single startup disabled log)? [Completeness, Spec Q7, Spec AC5, Plan §Part 2]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the debounce state machine fully specified (suspend only after `market_gate_bad_streak` consecutive FAIL, resume only after `market_gate_good_streak` consecutive PASS, all settings-driven), with WARN defined as a neutral hold that resets both streaks and never suspends/resumes, preventing flapping? [Completeness, Spec Q2, Spec AC6, data-model.md §3]
- [ ] CHK016 Is it specified that the gate blocks NEW ENTRIES ONLY while exits/position management (TP/SL/time-stop/regime exit) always run, tying to Constitution III? [Consistency, Spec Q6, Spec AC7, Constitution III]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the entry-block placement specified relative to the per-asset loop (after observation recording and after exit management, before the scalper call)? [Clarity, Plan §Part 2]
- [ ] CHK018 Is exactly ONE debounced notification per state transition specified (one on suspend, one on resume, zero on intermediate evaluations), delivered via `send_message` from `trading_bot/send_bot_message.py` (the same mechanism `_notify_entry` uses)? [Completeness, Spec Q3, Spec AC8, Plan §Part 2]
- [ ] CHK019 Are per-venue independent state machines specified (separate `_gate_state`/`_last_gate_eval`/`_gate_observations` dicts; a DEX suspension never affects CEX), including the venue-mode `"False"` skip so the gate is inactive for non-trading venues? [Completeness, data-model.md §6, Spec §Part 2, Plan §Part 2]
- [ ] CHK020 Are gate settings specified to be read FRESH each evaluation (Telegram/UI changes take effect without restart, per Constitution Operational), and is it clear the gate is an ADDITIONAL venue-level layer that does NOT replace existing per-asset guards? [Consistency, Spec §Part 2, Constitution Operational]
- [ ] CHK021 Is restart behavior of the in-memory gate state specified (starts unsuspended, re-establishes within `bad_streak × interval`, position/order reconciliation untouched — Constitution VI)? [Coverage, Plan Edge Cases, Constitution VI]

## Scan Freshness & Fail-Closed

- [ ] CHK022 Is it specified that a stale/due stored scan triggers `run_scans_if_due()`/`force_rescan` BEFORE evaluation in BOTH modes — the check never judges on stale data? [Completeness, Spec Q5, Spec AC3, Plan §Part 1]
- [ ] CHK023 Is "still stale after refresh ⇒ verdict FAIL (`scan_stale`)" specified as fail-closed per Constitution IV? [Consistency, data-model.md §2, Spec §Part 1]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the kill-switch-pause interaction specified (`run_scans_if_due` pauses under the consecutive-losses kill switch → stays stale ⇒ FAIL; entries already blocked by the kill switch — fail closed)? [Coverage, Plan Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the freshness predicate specified unambiguously as the single source of truth (`is_universe_stale` based on `universe_max_age_hours`)? [Clarity, research.md §4, Plan §Part 1]

## Settings — Registration & Validation

- [ ] CHK026 Are ALL SEVEN `market_gate_*` keys specified with type, default, hard range, and soft range (`enabled`, `interval_min`, `bad_streak`, `good_streak`, `fail_share`, `trend_share`, `unknown_share`)? [Completeness, data-model.md §4]
- [ ] CHK027 Is registration in `trade/settings_schema.py`'s `ALL` list under a new `"gate"` group (with `GROUPS`/`BY_KEY` derived) specified so the Amendment 002 validator accepts them, and is the no-DB-migration decision explicit (defaults live in `get_setting_*` fallbacks)? [Consistency, research.md §6, Plan §Part 4, Spec Q10, Plan Storage]
- [ ] CHK028 Is it specified that hard ranges enforce `interval >= 1` and `streak >= 1` so NO `trade/settings_rules.py` change is strictly necessary (Amendment 002 validator passes unchanged)? [Consistency, Plan §Part 4, research.md §6]
- [ ] CHK029 Are defaults specified as deliberately lenient so a healthy RANGE venue evaluates PASS (Constitution VIII, AC11), and is rejection of invalid values with clear messages specified (AC12)? [Measurability, Spec AC11, Spec AC12, data-model.md §4]

- [ ] CHK033 Is the live-snapshot mode for the manual report specified as token-bucket rate-limited exactly like the scanner (`_TokenBucket`, ≤ 1 depth call per universe member), and is the operator escape-hatch/override role (operator decides; same verdict shape) defined? ## Constitution Compliance

- [ ] CHK034 Are Constitutions I, II, and V (one strategy; reward exceeds risk; real fills only) explicitly stated as UNTOUCHED in the plan's Constitution Check? [Consistency, Plan Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK035 Are III and VI compliance explicitly tied to design choices (entries-only blocking; exit management runs before the gate check; restart safety and `_reconcile_startup` untouched)? [Consistency, Spec §Part 2, Plan Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK036 Is IV fail-closed compliance explicit and CONSISTENT across spec, plan, and data-model (stale ⇒ FAIL; missing data never passes; UNKNOWN never counts toward good; zero-observation venue never PASS ⇒ no resume on indeterminate data)? [Consistency, Spec §Part 1, Plan Constitution Check, data-model.md §1–2]
- [ ] CHK037 Is VII compliance specified with a line budget (bot.py grows ~35–45 lines via existing patterns; verdict logic + state machine live in non-hot-path `market_check.py`; no import from `trade/main.py` or `trade/signal_agent/`), and is the existing hot-path overage (2,148 lines) documented with its historical justification rather than silently exceeding budget? [Completeness, Plan Line-Budget Note, Constitution VII, Spec §Part 1]
- [ ] CHK038 Is VIII compliance specified (the gate must never create a near-zero-trade configuration; lenient defaults; WARN never suspends; skipped-entry reasons stay DEBUG and are recorded in `signals`)? [Consistency, Spec AC11, Plan Constitution Check, Constitution VIII]
